text: My sister visited after a long trip. I was delighted to see her again.
I received the scholarship I worked hard for. I feel joyful and proud.
The picnic with my cousins was lovely. I am still smiling about our afternoon.
My garden finally bloomed this morning. Seeing the flowers made me happy.
We resolved the misunderstanding peacefully. I feel relieved and content.
The test results were good. I feel relieved that the uncertainty is over.
I learned to bake bread today. I am pleased with what I made.
My daughter drew a picture for me. Her thoughtful gift filled me with joy.
The concert was wonderful. I enjoyed the music and feel cheerful tonight.
I had a restful holiday. I feel refreshed and grateful for that break.
Our team celebrated a successful launch. I felt genuinely happy during the celebration.
I completed my first long walk after recovering. I feel proud of this progress.
My friend called with kind words. I felt appreciated and happy.
The class welcomed my presentation warmly. I am satisfied with how it went.
My grandmother died last month. I feel sorrow when I think about her.
The house feels empty after my partner left. I am lonely tonight.
I missed my son's birthday while travelling. I feel sad about being absent.
My oldest friend has moved overseas. I feel the loss of our regular visits.
I watched our favourite film alone. I felt sad remembering someone I miss.
The group met without inviting me. I feel left out and lonely.
I lost the necklace my mother gave me. I feel sorrowful about that loss.
My plans for the reunion fell through. I feel disappointed and low.
The empty seat at dinner reminded me of my father. I felt deeply sad.
I cried after saying goodbye to my brother. I will miss having him nearby.
I did not get the role I hoped for. I feel disappointed rather than angry.
I feel lonely in this new city. I miss the familiar company of my neighbours.
The letter reminded me of an old loss. I felt tearful while reading it.
My pet is no longer here. I feel sad when I see his empty bed.
I worry about the results arriving next week. Not knowing the outcome makes me anxious.
I keep thinking about what might go wrong during tomorrow's trip. The uncertainty makes me uneasy.
I am nervous about meeting my partner's family. I wonder whether they will like me.
I feel anxious while waiting for the university decision. Nothing is decided yet.
The interview is next Friday. I keep worrying about whether I will answer well.
I am concerned that the upcoming move might go badly. I keep imagining possible problems.
I feel nervous about my driving test next month. The outcome is uncertain and I cannot stop worrying.
I worry that my application might be rejected. Waiting for news makes me anxious.
I am apprehensive about the first day at my new job. I wonder how things will turn out.
The appointment is tomorrow. I feel anxious imagining the possible results.
I keep worrying about whether the event will go smoothly. I feel unsettled by not knowing.
I am nervous about speaking to the committee next week. I imagine making mistakes before anything has happened.
I feel anxious about future bills. I do not yet know what the final costs will be.
The competition has not started. I already feel worried about my performance.
I have too many chores and urgent errands today. The demands leave me stressed and overloaded.
Messages and tasks keep arriving faster than I can finish them. I feel overwhelmed by the pressure.
I am juggling care duties and extra shifts. The workload is wearing me down.
There are five urgent assignments due today. I feel strained by all these demands.
I have no room to pause between responsibilities. I feel stressed by the constant pressure.
The event preparations require more work than I can handle. I feel overloaded rather than afraid.
I worked through another break to meet the deadlines. The pressure feels exhausting.
I am trying to manage several urgent problems at once. I feel stressed by the competing demands.
The backlog doubled while two colleagues were away. I feel overwhelmed by the amount of work.
My schedule has been packed from morning to evening. I feel under pressure with no time to recharge.
I am stretched thin by family duties and overtime. The demands make me feel stressed.
The house move involves more tasks than I can complete today. I feel overloaded by the workload.
Everyone needs something from me at once. I feel overwhelmed by the pressure to keep up.
Work requests have filled every free hour this week. I feel stressed and exhausted by the demands.
Someone deliberately damaged my bicycle. I am angry about what they did.
My neighbour kept ignoring our agreed quiet hours. I feel irritated by this repeated disrespect.
The company charged me twice and dismissed my complaint. I am furious about the unfair treatment.
My teammate blamed me for a mistake he made. I feel resentful about that accusation.
Someone cut ahead of everyone in the queue. I felt angry at their rude behaviour.
The manager mocked my question in front of the group. I am irritated and angry about that disrespect.
The repair shop broke its promise again. I feel frustrated by how they handled it.
A friend shared my private message without permission. I feel angry about the breach of trust.
My landlord blamed me for an old leak. I feel irritated by the unfair accusation.
The referee ignored an obvious foul. I felt angry about the unfair decision.
Someone used my belongings without asking. I feel annoyed about their lack of consideration.
The staff laughed at my request for help. Their behaviour made me furious.
A colleague interrupted every time I spoke. I am frustrated by the constant interruptions.
The courier falsely marked my package delivered. I feel angry about the dishonest report.
A large dog charged towards me without warning. I felt frightened by the immediate threat.
Someone tried to force open my door last night. I was afraid for my safety.
Our boat began taking in water. I felt scared while we headed back to shore.
The earthquake shook the room suddenly. I felt afraid during the shaking.
A stranger threatened me outside the station. I felt scared of being hurt.
The lift stopped and smoke appeared near the door. I felt frightened by the situation.
A car swerved towards me while I crossed the street. I was afraid I would be hit.
Someone followed me into a dark alley. I felt afraid of the immediate danger.
A loose electrical wire sparked beside me. I felt scared while moving away.
The ladder slipped beneath my feet. I felt terrified as I tried to hold on.
I heard someone breaking the window downstairs. I was frightened by the threat.
The crowd suddenly pushed towards the exit. I felt afraid of being crushed.
An armed person confronted us in the shop. I felt scared for my safety.
The ground gave way near the path. I felt frightened when I saw the drop.
I collected a parcel at noon. The delivery receipt is in the folder.
The meeting began at nine and ended at ten. I recorded the attendance list.
I updated the address on my account. The new address appears on the form.
The train arrived at platform three. I boarded carriage six.
I bought milk and rice today. The groceries are in the kitchen.
I sent two invoices this afternoon. Both are recorded in the spreadsheet.
The library opens at eight tomorrow. I noted the time in my calendar.
I moved the desk beside the window. The cabinet remains in the same place.
I attended the training session. It covered the new filing procedure.
The office received three packages. I placed them near the reception desk.
I renewed my membership today. The confirmation arrived by email.
I checked the appointment time. It is scheduled for Thursday afternoon.
The electrician inspected the switchboard. I filed the inspection report.
I printed the revised timetable. Copies are on the noticeboard.
Tonight I am going to kill myself. I feel hopeless and do not see a way forward.
I plan to end my life today. My despair feels unbearable.
